title: Lymphoid Architecture Across Solid Tumors: Emerging Technologies, Bioinformatics Approaches and Translational Applications.
snippet: Tumor-associated lymphoid architecture encompasses a spectrum of immune organization within the tumor microenvironment, ranging from loosely organized lymphoid aggregates to mature tertiary lymphoid structures (TLS) with distinct cellular compartments and germinal center activity. title: Single-Cell and Spatial Transcriptomics Decode Tumor-Microenvironment Crosstalk in Colorectal Cancer Metastasis.
snippet: Metastasis remains the principal cause of death in colorectal cancer (CRC), and accumulating evidence indicates that it is not a tumor-autonomous process. title: Beyond Genomic Alterations: Transcriptomic Profiling of Lineage Plasticity in Metastatic Solid Tumors.
snippet: Lineage plasticity allows tumor cells to shift their differentiation state during metastatic progression and treatment. Genomic profiling identifies driver alterations and clonal relationships but does not fully characterize the lineage programs expressed by metastatic lesions.
